desk.why: Implied is only 0.88x the forecast, below the 1.10x a seller needs.

facts: NIFTY moved -0.1% over the last 7 sessions and -0.6% on the day, to 25,228.
Gap -64 pts, then the session added -95 pts.
The day closed in the lower half (close - low 86, high - close 163).
ATM IV sits in its 73rd percentile of the past year: option premium is rich - selling it pays more, but moves are expected to be bigger.

base.why: No trend worth leaning on (7-session move -0.1%), so the plan sells both sides at the writers' walls, 25,000 and 25,300, and lets time decay work. Note: the desk's volatility rule says stand aside today (Implied is only 0.88x the forecast, below the 1.10x a seller needs.). This plan overrides it only for the scenario branches; size down.
text: bull put spread: sell 24,800 PE, buy 24,600 PE (credit about 35 pts, Rs 2,304 per lot; max loss Rs 10,696)
bear call spread: sell 26,000 CE, buy 26,200 CE (credit about 21 pts, Rs 1,375 per lot; max loss Rs 11,625)

scenarios.title: Drifts sideways between 25,000 and 25,300
watch: Two daily closes below 25,300 without a new high
Close - open (the body) small, either colour
scenarios.means: The move is pausing. Time decay is working for the seller.
scenarios.action: Hold. Take profit once 50% of the credit is earned.

scenarios.title: Reaches 25,300 and stalls
watch: High - close bigger than close - low (sellers took it back)
25,300 CE open interest still rising (call writers defending)
scenarios.means: Call writers are defending 25,300. A ceiling for now.
scenarios.action: Close today's position (take the profit) and open the new one. It would be about Rs 989 in profit per lot here (estimated). Weekly: sell an iron condor, sell 25,300 CE / buy 25,500 CE / sell 24,800 PE / buy 24,600 PE. Call writers are defending 25,300: sell calls at the wall and keep a put spread under the market, so both sides earn while it stalls.

scenarios.title: Breaks out above 25,300
watch: 25,300 CE open interest falling (writers buying back - short covering)
Close near the day's high again
scenarios.means: The ceiling gave way. Next magnets: 25,400 then 25,500.
scenarios.action: Close today's position (take the profit) and open the new one. It would be about Rs 1,000 in profit per lot here (estimated). Weekly: sell a spread, sell 25,300 PE / buy 25,100 PE. The old ceiling 25,300 becomes the floor: sell puts at it. No calls below 25,500. Or buy a spread: buy 25,400 CE / sell 25,800 CE. If it spikes past 25,400 in one session with VIX rising, take profit instead of chasing.
scenarios.odds: Reached 25,400 in 67.6% and 25,500 in 57.0% of past cases (normal 70.9% / 62.2%).

scenarios.title: Falls to 25,000 and holds
watch: 25,000 PE open interest still rising (put writers defending)
scenarios.action: If it holds: keep today's position, or add nothing (weekly). If it breaks: close today's position and switch to sell 25,000 CE / buy 25,200 CE (weekly). Exact strikes for every expiry are in the position matrix.
scenarios.odds: Dipped to 25,000 in 60.3% of past cases (normal 55.8%).

scenarios.title: Breaks down below 25,000
watch: 25,000 PE open interest falling (put writers exiting)
scenarios.means: The floor gave way. Next: 24,800 then 24,500.
scenarios.action: Close today's position. It would be about Rs 578 in loss per lot here (estimated). Weekly: sell a spread, sell 25,000 CE / buy 25,200 CE. The old floor 25,000 becomes the ceiling: sell calls at it. Or buy a spread: buy 24,900 PE / sell 24,500 PE.
scenarios.odds: Dipped to 24,800 in 43.3% of past cases (normal 41.1%).

rules: Take profit on any spread once 50% of its credit is earned; the rest is not worth the risk.
Close any spread once its loss reaches 1.5x the credit taken, whatever day that is. Holding into expiry is fine; size smaller on expiry day.
Act on daily closes, not intraday spikes. The OI checks use the next morning's bhavcopy.
Credits for rolls and add-ons are set by prices on the day you act; today's numbers are a guide only.
limits: None of the desk's positioning signals (PCR, max pain, OI flow, walls) has passed its own backtest for this horizon, so the history study is the main evidence.
